Name: Agent Focus: Yanagi
Desc: Use it to obtain the Agent or unlock the Agent's Mindscapes.
Desc2:
Snapshots from Tsukishiro Yanagi's daily life and from in combat, recording important moments before and after she became an Agent.
These images also provide insights into her fighting style and favorite weapons, helping to better understand her strengths.

There are so many everyday moments between Tsukishiro Yanagi and Soukaku! Ah, when Yanagi is gentle, she really does feel like Soukaku's mother...
